name: D3 ❤️ React
summary: Cohort-based course on building custom interactive charts and data visualizations with D3.js and React.
description: An online course by Yan Holtz that teaches building custom, interactive charts with D3.js and React, from SVG, scales and axes to responsiveness, hover effects, tooltips, data fetching and animation. Ten modules of lessons and exercises, worked examples from the React Graph Gallery, and a student gallery; three free lessons, next cohort by waitlist.
contains: 10 modules from web and React foundations to SVG, scales, axes, tooltips and animation
lessons and hands-on exercises in every module
reusable components: axes, tooltip, responsive chart template
500+ students across the first two cohorts
